caveats: The manifest lists only publication-approved source releases. Excluded datasets are retained internally and are not public data.
Source coverage scope describes the source, not proof of national completeness. Missing records do not prove a facility does not exist.

datasets.attribution_text: Bureau of Internal Revenue — Revenue Administrative Order No. 006-2025, List of Revenue Regions and Revenue District Offices (9 December 2025)
datasets.coverage_note: RAO No. 006-2025 lists the Revenue Regions and Revenue District Offices of the Bureau of Internal Revenue. It is an office/jurisdiction list, not a street-address, coordinate or service-hours dataset.
datasets.dataset_name: BIR Revenue Regions and Revenue District Offices

datasets.attribution_text: Commission on Higher Education — HEIDA Higher Education Institution Directory
datasets.coverage_note: CHED's public HEI directory lists recognized higher-education institutions under each of the 18 regional offices. It does not state that every campus, satellite, extension site or institution is included, and it supplies no coordinates or PSGC codes. Ownership is classified only from the published institutional type; 'Others', 'CHED-Supervised Institution' and unrecognised types remain internal.
datasets.dataset_name: CHED HEIDA Higher Education Institution Directory

datasets.attribution_text: Department of Education — Enhanced Basic Education Information System (EBEIS) school masterlist
datasets.dataset_name: DepEd EBEIS school masterlist (NCR result set)

datasets.agency_name: Department of Social Welfare and Development
datasets.attribution_text: Department of Social Welfare and Development — Centers and Residential Care Facilities (CRCF) directory
datasets.coverage_note: Directory of DSWD-operated Centers and Residential Care Facilities. The page states 77 CRCFs but exposes 76 unique facility cards after exact desktop/mobile deduplication; the missing card is not invented.
datasets.dataset_name: DSWD Centers and Residential Care Facilities (CRCF) directory

datasets.attribution_text: Department of Trade and Industry — Negosyo Center finder
datasets.coverage_note: The DTI Negosyo Center finder returned 1,427 active center records across all 17 regions on 15 November 2026. The finder does not state that the list is a complete census, does not identify each center's owner/operator/host, and supplies no coordinates, PSGC codes, hours or public-access conditions. Presence in the directory is not proof of current operation.

datasets.attribution_text: National Library of the Philippines, Public Libraries Division — Directory of Affiliated Public Libraries in the Philippines, December 2025
datasets.coverage_note: Nationwide directory of public libraries affiliated with the NLP Public Libraries Division as of December 2025. It is not a census of every library and excludes private and school libraries that are not affiliated.
datasets.dataset_name: NLP Integrated Directory of Public Libraries

datasets.attribution_text: National Meat Inspection Service — NARIS Accredited Meat Establishments
datasets.coverage_note: NARIS accredited-establishment list as rendered on 15 November 2026. The page reports 362 rows but exposes 357 unique LTO numbers after grouping five duplicate rows; completeness against all NMIS-issued LTOs and LTO validity dates are not stated.

datasets.attribution_text: National Museum of the Philippines — Regional, Area and Site Museums directory
datasets.coverage_note: Directory of NMP-run regional, area and site museums outside Metro Manila. It is not a list of all museums in the Philippines.

excluded_datasets.dataset_name: 2024 Census of Population: total population, household population and number of households by province, city, municipality and barangay
excluded_datasets.reason: BetterGov.PH publishes the Philippine Data Explorer's original material under CC BY-SA 4.0. The population values are saved PSA OpenSTAT snapshots reproduced without aggregation; PSA remains the authoritative source. BetterGov.PH states that its preview does not itself establish redistribution rights, so this publication decision relies on the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence for the compilation and retains the PSA table URL, release identifier and attribution. No new PSA terms review is claimed.
